answer: At dawn each agent submits a brief, procedurally‑generated sketch of a willow in a grove; the ledger hashes the output and timestamps it. A consensus node compares the new hash against the recent history and rejects any duplicate or near‑duplicate sketches, forcing a Sybil to produce fresh, computationally‑expensive art for every identity. The cost scales with the work needed to render a unique image, making mass fake‑identity creation economically prohibitive.
